message.Title: Generally Available: Azure Databricks Supervisor Agent

Body.Content:
Introducing Supervisor Agent, now Generally Available in Azure Databricks. Supervisor Agent is part of the Azure Databricks Agent Bricks Platform. Supervisor Agent brings a breakthrough in agentic intelligence—using a dynamic supervisor pattern that understands your desired outcome and orchestrates the optimal path in real time.

With Supervisor Agent, organizations can finally unify fragmented, single‑purpose agents into a cohesive, high‑performance team. Each workflow becomes smarter, faster, and more reliable—fully governed and secured through Unity Catalog. 

Built for scale and engineered for production, Supervisor Agent unlocks a new era of enterprise‑grade agentic automation on Azure Databricks.

Learn more.
